info.title: Cailyx API
info.description:
Cailyx backend API — an AI-visibility / answer-engine-optimization (AEO) platform for auditing, measuring, and improving how brands are represented across search and AI-answer surfaces (ChatGPT, SERPs, etc.), plus the operator/client-portal and sales-pipeline tooling built around it.

All routes are served under the `/api` prefix. Authentication is JWT bearer (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`), enforced globally except on routes explicitly marked public (login, register, refresh, logout, health check, Google OAuth callback). Some routes are further restricted to specific operator roles (see `x-roles`) or to the client-portal surface (`x-client-portal`).
